description.en: Moving to South Carolina triggers a 60-day SEP. SC has not expanded Medicaid. Compare Marketplace, Healthy Connections Kids CHIP, and COBRA options for 2026.

h1.en: Moving to South Carolina in 2026? Here Is How to Get Health Insurance
h1.es: Mudandose a Carolina del Sur en 2026? Asi Consigue Seguro Medico

subhero.en: You have 60 days from your South Carolina move date to enroll in a new Marketplace plan. South Carolina has not expanded Medicaid, which significantly affects your options if your income is low.
subhero.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de mudanza a Carolina del Sur para inscribirse en un nuevo plan. Carolina del Sur no ha expandido Medicaid, lo cual afecta sus opciones si sus ingresos son bajos.

heading.en: You have 60 days from your South Carolina move date to enroll
heading.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de mudanza a Carolina del Sur para inscribirse

body.en: Your 60-day Special Enrollment Period runs from the day you establish South Carolina residency, for example June 13 through August 12 if you moved on June 13, 2026. Miss that window and you must wait until ACA Open Enrollment in November 2026 (for 2027 coverage) unless another qualifying life event occurs. South Carolina does not operate its own state exchange, so all ACA enrollment goes through healthcare.gov.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias corre desde el dia que establece residencia en Carolina del Sur, por ejemplo del 13 de junio al 12 de agosto si se mudo el 13 de junio de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana, debe esperar hasta la Inscripcion Abierta del ACA en noviembre de 2026 a menos que ocurra otro evento calificador de vida.

quickAnswer.en: Moving to South Carolina triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period (SEP) starting from your move date. South Carolina uses the federal Marketplace at healthcare.gov for ACA plan enrollment. The critical difference from most states: South Carolina has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA. Standard Healthy Connections (SC Medicaid) for non-disabled adults without dependent children is extremely limited. Adults below 100% of the Federal Poverty Level ($15,960 single in 2026) face a coverage gap as they earn too little for ACA subsidies and too much for Healthy Connections. Children under 19 can enroll year-round in Healthy Connections Kids (South Carolina CHIP) at household incomes up to approximately 208% FPL. If your income falls between 100% and 400% FPL ($15,960 to $63,840 single in 2026), healthcare.gov Marketplace plans with premium tax credits are the primary option for most SC adults who move in.
quickAnswer.es: Mudarse a Carolina del Sur activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 60 dias desde la fecha de mudanza. Carolina del Sur usa el Mercado federal en healthcare.gov para la inscripcion de planes ACA. La diferencia critica con la mayoria de los estados: Carolina del Sur no ha expandido Medicaid bajo el ACA. El Healthy Connections estandar (Medicaid de SC) para adultos sin dependientes es extremadamente limitado. Los adultos por debajo del 100% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($15,960 soltero en 2026) enfrentan una brecha de cobertura. Los ninos menores de 19 pueden inscribirse durante todo el ano en Healthy Connections Kids (CHIP de Carolina del Sur) con ingresos hasta aproximadamente el 208% FPL. Si sus ingresos estan entre el 100% y el 400% FPL, los planes del Mercado en healthcare.gov con creditos fiscales de prima son la opcion principal.

introParagraphs.en: Moving to South Carolina creates an immediate health coverage decision, and the stakes are higher than in most states because South Carolina is one of 10 states that has not expanded Medicaid under the Affordable Care Act. The 40 expansion states plus DC extend free Medicaid to adults with incomes up to 138% of the Federal Poverty Level ($22,025 single, $45,540 family of 4 in 2026 per HHS ASPE guidelines). South Carolina does not. South Carolina's Medicaid program, called Healthy Connections and administered by the South Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (SCDHHS), generally covers only narrow categories: pregnant women (to approximately 194% FPL), children (Healthy Connections Kids to approximately 208% FPL), seniors and people with disabilities, and parents of dependent minor children at only approximately 62% FPL. Non-disabled adults without dependent children fall entirely outside Healthy Connections eligibility regardless of income. The 60-day Special Enrollment Period is your primary safety net for finding coverage after a South Carolina move. South Carolina uses the federally-facilitated Marketplace at healthcare.gov rather than a state-run exchange, so enrollment is centralized. Applying within the first two weeks of your move typically produces coverage starting the first of the following month, minimizing any gap between old coverage and new.
introParagraphs.es: Mudarse a Carolina del Sur crea una decision inmediata de cobertura medica, y las consecuencias son mas significativas que en la mayoria de los estados porque Carolina del Sur es uno de los 10 estados que no ha expandido Medicaid bajo la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible. Los 40 estados de expansion mas DC extienden Medicaid gratuito a adultos con ingresos hasta el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($22,025 soltero, $45,540 familia de 4 en 2026). Carolina del Sur no. El programa Medicaid de Carolina del Sur, llamado Healthy Connections y administrado por el Departamento de Salud y Servicios Humanos de Carolina del Sur (SCDHHS), generalmente cubre solo categorias limitadas. El Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias es su principal red de seguridad para encontrar cobertura despues de una mudanza a Carolina del Sur. Carolina del Sur usa el Mercado federal en healthcare.gov, por lo que la inscripcion es centralizada.

introParagraphs.en: South Carolina's non-expansion status creates a coverage gap for an estimated 105,000 South Carolina adults who earn between 0% and 100% FPL and do not qualify for Healthy Connections or ACA Marketplace subsidies. Federal law set 100% FPL ($15,960 single in 2026) as the floor for ACA premium tax credits. Without Medicaid expansion, adults below that floor have no subsidized coverage pathway in South Carolina. Children fare far better: Healthy Connections Kids provides CHIP coverage for South Carolina residents under age 19 at household incomes up to approximately 208% FPL ($33,197 for a single adult with a child, approximately $68,640 for a family of 4 in 2026), and enrollment is year-round with no premiums and no cost-sharing. Check ACA income limits to see if your projected South Carolina income qualifies for premium tax credits, or review Medicaid income limits for the 2026 thresholds by household size. Most adults moving to South Carolina with incomes between 100% and 400% FPL ($15,960 to $63,840 single in 2026) will find that healthcare.gov Marketplace plans with premium tax credits are their best option, with Silver plans often available for $10 to $150 per month after the 2026 credit.
introParagraphs.es: El estado de no expansion de Carolina del Sur crea una brecha de cobertura para aproximadamente 105,000 adultos de Carolina del Sur que ganan entre el 0% y el 100% FPL. La ley federal establece el 100% FPL ($15,960 soltero en 2026) como el piso para los creditos fiscales de prima del ACA. Sin la expansion de Medicaid, los adultos por debajo de ese piso no tienen un camino de cobertura subsidiada en Carolina del Sur. Los ninos tienen mejores opciones: Healthy Connections Kids proporciona cobertura CHIP para residentes de Carolina del Sur menores de 19 anos con ingresos hasta aproximadamente el 208% FPL, y la inscripcion es durante todo el ano sin primas ni costo compartido. La mayoria de los adultos que se mudan a Carolina del Sur con ingresos entre el 100% y el 400% FPL encontraran que los planes del Mercado de healthcare.gov con creditos fiscales de prima son su mejor opcion, con planes Silver a menudo disponibles por $10 a $150 al mes despues del credito 2026.

name.en: Establish your South Carolina move date and document it
name.es: Establezca su fecha de mudanza a Carolina del Sur y documentela

text.en: Your 60-day SEP clock starts the day you establish South Carolina residency. Collect documentation immediately: a signed lease or mortgage statement with your South Carolina address, a utility bill, a bank statement, or a South Carolina driver's license application. Healthcare.gov will require at least one of these documents to verify the qualifying life event when you enroll. Missing or delayed documentation is the top reason SEP applications get flagged for manual review.
text.es: El reloj del SEP de 60 dias comienza el dia que establece residencia en Carolina del Sur. Reuna documentacion de inmediato: contrato de arrendamiento o estado hipotecario con su direccion de Carolina del Sur, factura de servicios publicos, estado bancario, o solicitud de licencia de conducir de Carolina del Sur. Healthcare.gov requerira al menos uno de estos documentos para verificar el evento calificador de vida al inscribirse.

name.en: Check Healthy Connections Medicaid eligibility for your household
name.es: Verifique la elegibilidad para Healthy Connections Medicaid para su hogar

text.en: Check Healthy Connections eligibility at scdhhs.gov or apply at the Healthy Connections Citizen Portal at apply.scdhhs.gov. Healthy Connections Kids covers children under 19 at household incomes up to approximately 208% FPL with no premiums or cost-sharing. Pregnant women may qualify at incomes up to approximately 194% FPL. Parents and caretaker relatives face a very low income limit of approximately 62% FPL ($9,895 per year single parent in 2026). Non-disabled adults without dependent children do not qualify for standard Healthy Connections at any income level. Healthy Connections enrollment is year-round with no SEP deadline required.
text.es: Verifique la elegibilidad de Healthy Connections en scdhhs.gov o solicite en el Portal Ciudadano de Healthy Connections en apply.scdhhs.gov. Healthy Connections Kids cubre ninos menores de 19 anos con ingresos hasta aproximadamente el 208% FPL sin primas ni costo compartido. Las mujeres embarazadas pueden calificar con ingresos hasta aproximadamente el 194% FPL. Los padres y tutores enfrentan un limite de ingresos muy bajo de aproximadamente el 62% FPL. Los adultos sin discapacidad y sin hijos dependientes no califican para Healthy Connections estandar a ninguna nivel de ingresos. La inscripcion de Healthy Connections es durante todo el ano.

name.en: Calculate your projected South Carolina income for ACA subsidy eligibility
name.es: Calcule su ingreso proyectado en Carolina del Sur para elegibilidad de subsidios del ACA

text.en: ACA Marketplace premium tax credits for South Carolina plans use your projected annual Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) from your move date through December 31, 2026. For 2026, the subsidy range is 100% to 400% FPL ($15,960 to $63,840 for a single adult per the 2026 HHS ASPE Poverty Guidelines). Incomes above 400% FPL do not qualify for premium tax credits in 2026 because the enhanced ACA subsidies from the American Rescue Plan Act expired January 1, 2026. Use your best forward-looking income estimate, not your prior-state income history.
text.es: Los creditos fiscales de prima del Mercado ACA para planes de Carolina del Sur usan su Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) proyectado anual desde la fecha de mudanza hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2026. Para 2026, el rango de subsidios es del 100% al 400% FPL ($15,960 a $63,840 para un adulto soltero). Los ingresos superiores al 400% FPL no califican para creditos fiscales de prima en 2026 porque los subsidios mejorados del ACA de la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026. Use su mejor estimacion prospectiva de ingresos, no su historial de ingresos del estado anterior.

name.en: Enroll in a South Carolina Marketplace plan at healthcare.gov using the move SEP
name.es: Inscribase en un plan del Mercado de Carolina del Sur en healthcare.gov usando el SEP de mudanza

text.en: Log in to healthcare.gov and select 'I moved to a new coverage area' as your qualifying life event. Enter your new South Carolina ZIP code to see available plans. South Carolina is a federally-facilitated marketplace state with no separate state portal. Compare Silver, Gold, and Bronze plans by monthly premium, deductible, and the in-network provider directory for your South Carolina county. Silver plans also qualify for cost-sharing reduction (CSR) subsidies if your income is 100% to 250% FPL, reducing your deductible significantly. Coverage typically starts the first day of the month after you enroll if you apply by the 15th.
text.es: Inicie sesion en healthcare.gov y seleccione 'Me mude a una nueva area de cobertura' como su evento calificador de vida. Ingrese su nuevo codigo postal de Carolina del Sur para ver los planes disponibles. Carolina del Sur es un estado con mercado federal; no hay portal estatal separado. Compare planes Silver, Gold y Bronze por prima mensual, deducible y directorio de proveedores en red para su condado de Carolina del Sur. Los planes Silver tambien califican para subsidios de reduccion de costo compartido (CSR) si su ingreso es del 100% al 250% FPL.

name.en: If you have employer coverage, verify your South Carolina address is in-network
name.es: Si tiene cobertura del empleador, verifique que su direccion en Carolina del Sur esta en la red

text.en: Call HR or check the plan's provider directory for your new South Carolina ZIP code. PPO plans frequently have national networks, but HMO and EPO plans may have no in-network providers in your South Carolina county. If the employer plan does not cover your new area, request a Special Enrollment Period from HR. Under HIPAA Section 9831, a permanent move that creates a change in plan network availability is a qualifying event, and most employers allow a 30-day window to enroll in a different option.
text.es: Llame a Recursos Humanos o revise el directorio de proveedores del plan para su nuevo codigo postal de Carolina del Sur. Los planes PPO frecuentemente tienen redes nacionales, pero los planes HMO y EPO pueden no tener proveedores en red en su condado de Carolina del Sur. Si el plan del empleador no cubre su nueva area, solicite un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial a traves de Recursos Humanos.

name.en: Cancel your prior state's coverage and preserve termination documentation
name.es: Cancele la cobertura de su estado anterior y conserve la documentacion de terminacion

text.en: Log in to your old state's marketplace or healthcare.gov and terminate your prior plan effective your South Carolina move date. If you had Medicaid in your prior state, notify that state's Medicaid agency in writing. Keep the written termination notice as documentation. Maintaining simultaneous Marketplace coverage in two states creates subsidy reconciliation problems on your 1095-A when you file your 2026 federal taxes, since the IRS reconciles any excess advance premium tax credit on your return.
text.es: Inicie sesion en el mercado de su estado anterior o healthcare.gov y cancele su plan anterior con vigencia en la fecha de mudanza a Carolina del Sur. Si tenia Medicaid en su estado anterior, notifique por escrito a la agencia de Medicaid de ese estado. Conserve el aviso de terminacion como documentacion. Mantener cobertura simultanea del Mercado en dos estados crea problemas de reconciliacion de subsidios en el formulario 1095-A al presentar sus impuestos federales 2026.

name.en: Submit proof of prior coverage to complete the SEP application
name.es: Envie prueba de cobertura anterior para completar la solicitud SEP

text.en: Healthcare.gov requires proof that you had minimum essential coverage for at least one of the 60 days before your move date to qualify for the move SEP. Submit a HIPAA Certificate of Creditable Coverage from your prior insurer, your old COBRA notice, or a prior-state Medicaid termination letter. Someone who was uninsured before moving to South Carolina does not qualify for the move SEP and must wait for the next ACA Open Enrollment Period (November 1 through December 15, 2026 for 2027 coverage, under the new shorter OEP window) or another qualifying life event.
text.es: Healthcare.gov requiere prueba de que tuvo cobertura minima esencial durante al menos uno de los 60 dias antes de la fecha de mudanza para calificar para el SEP de mudanza. Envie un Certificado de Cobertura Acreditable de HIPAA de su aseguradora anterior, su aviso de COBRA, o una carta de terminacion de Medicaid del estado anterior. Alguien que no tenia seguro antes de mudarse a Carolina del Sur no califica para el SEP de mudanza.

en: Proof of South Carolina residency: signed lease, mortgage statement, utility bill, or bank statement at your new South Carolina address (dated within 60 days of move)

Proof of prior minimum essential coverage: HIPAA Certificate of Creditable Coverage, prior Marketplace termination notice, prior employer coverage termination letter, or prior-state Medicaid termination letter
Social Security numbers for everyone applying (required for healthcare.gov enrollment and Healthy Connections / Healthy Connections Kids applications)
Move date documentation: moving company receipt, U-Haul contract, or dated lease commencement confirming when South Carolina residency began
Proof of income: recent pay stubs (last 2 to 4 weeks), employer letter, unemployment award letter, or prior-year federal tax return (Form 1040) for self-employed applicants
South Carolina driver's license or state ID application receipt (if recently applied; confirms residency intent)
Prior insurance card or plan details (to look up and submit creditable coverage certificate under HIPAA Section 9831)
Birth certificates for dependent children (if applying for Healthy Connections Kids CHIP or adding dependents to a Marketplace plan)
es: Prueba de residencia en Carolina del Sur: contrato de arrendamiento firmado, estado hipotecario, factura de servicios publicos, o estado bancario con su nueva direccion de Carolina del Sur (fechado dentro de 60 dias de la mudanza)

Prueba de cobertura minima esencial anterior: Certificado de Cobertura Acreditable de HIPAA, aviso de terminacion de Mercado anterior, carta de terminacion de cobertura del empleador anterior, o carta de terminacion de Medicaid del estado anterior
Numeros de Seguro Social para todos los que solicitan (requerido para inscripcion en healthcare.gov y solicitudes de Healthy Connections / Healthy Connections Kids)
Documentacion de fecha de mudanza: recibo de empresa de mudanza, contrato de U-Haul, o fecha de inicio del arrendamiento confirmando cuando comenzo la residencia en Carolina del Sur

Prueba de ingresos: talones de pago recientes (ultimas 2 a 4 semanas), carta del empleador, carta de asignacion de desempleo, o declaracion de impuestos federal del ano anterior (Formulario 1040) para solicitantes por cuenta propia
Solicitud de licencia de conducir o identificacion estatal de Carolina del Sur (si solicito recientemente; confirma intencion de residencia)
Tarjeta de seguro anterior o detalles del plan (para obtener y enviar certificado de cobertura acreditable bajo la Seccion 9831 de HIPAA)
Actas de nacimiento de hijos dependientes (si solicita Healthy Connections Kids CHIP o agrega dependientes a un plan del Mercado)

stateRules.rule: South Carolina has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA. Standard Healthy Connections (SC Medicaid) covers only narrow categories: pregnant women (to approximately 194% FPL), children under 19 (Healthy Connections Kids to approximately 208% FPL), seniors and people with disabilities, and parents of dependent minor children at a very low threshold of approximately 62% FPL. Non-disabled adults without dependent children do not qualify for standard Healthy Connections at any income level, creating a coverage gap for an estimated 105,000 South Carolina adults who earn below 100% FPL.

Healthy Connections Kids is South Carolina's CHIP program, providing free health insurance with no premiums or cost-sharing to uninsured children under age 19 in households with incomes up to approximately 208% of the Federal Poverty Level. Enrollment is year-round through the Healthy Connections Citizen Portal at apply.scdhhs.gov or by calling SCDHHS at 1-888-549-0820.

South Carolina uses the federally-facilitated Marketplace (healthcare.gov) and does not operate a state-based exchange. All ACA Marketplace enrollment, SEP claims, and plan selection for South Carolina residents goes through healthcare.gov. Effective 2026 to 2027 coverage, the ACA Open Enrollment Period is shorter: November 1 through December 15, 2026 (down from January 15 under prior rule).

South Carolina Medicaid (Healthy Connections) provides retroactive coverage for up to 3 months prior to the application month for some eligible individuals, including pregnant women. This retroactive window applies only to eligible Healthy Connections categories (not to adults who do not qualify for standard Medicaid). Applicants should apply as early as possible to maximize retroactive coverage.

en: Missing the 60-day SEP window: SEP applications submitted after Day 60 from the South Carolina move date are rejected; you must then wait until the next ACA Open Enrollment in November 2026 (closes December 15, 2026 for 2027 coverage)

Lacking proof of prior coverage: healthcare.gov requires documentation that you had minimum essential coverage for at least one of the 60 days before the move; uninsured movers do not qualify for the move SEP

Submitting South Carolina documentation that does not confirm the move date: a lease with a future start date, a utility bill from before the move, or a PO box does not confirm South Carolina residency on a specific date

Applying for standard Healthy Connections Medicaid as a non-disabled adult without dependents: non-elderly, non-disabled adults without dependent children do not qualify for standard Healthy Connections at any income level in South Carolina; apply for the ACA Marketplace instead

Reporting prior-year income instead of projected 2026 South Carolina income for ACA subsidy calculation: the Marketplace uses forward-looking MAGI from your move date through year-end, not your income in another state earlier in the year
es: Perder la ventana del SEP de 60 dias: las solicitudes de SEP enviadas despues del dia 60 desde la fecha de mudanza a Carolina del Sur son rechazadas; debe esperar hasta la proxima Inscripcion Abierta del ACA en noviembre de 2026 (cierra el 15 de diciembre de 2026 para cobertura 2027)

Falta de prueba de cobertura anterior: healthcare.gov requiere documentacion de que tuvo cobertura minima esencial durante al menos uno de los 60 dias antes de la mudanza; los que se mudaron sin seguro no califican para el SEP de mudanza

Enviar documentacion de Carolina del Sur que no confirma la fecha de mudanza: un arrendamiento con fecha de inicio futura, una factura de servicios de antes de la mudanza, o un apartado postal no confirman la residencia en Carolina del Sur en una fecha especifica

Solicitar Healthy Connections Medicaid estandar como adulto sin dependientes: los adultos no mayores sin hijos dependientes no califican para Healthy Connections estandar a ningun nivel de ingresos en Carolina del Sur; solicite el Mercado ACA en su lugar

Reportar ingresos del ano anterior en lugar de los ingresos proyectados del 2026 para el calculo de subsidios del ACA: el Mercado usa el MAGI prospectivo desde la fecha de mudanza hasta fin de ano, no sus ingresos en otro estado antes en el ano

intro.en: The most costly mistakes people make when moving to South Carolina and switching health coverage:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que comete la gente al mudarse a Carolina del Sur y cambiar cobertura medica:

items.en: Assuming South Carolina has expanded Medicaid. South Carolina is one of 10 non-expansion states as of 2026. Adults moving from expansion states like California, New York, or Illinois lose Medicaid eligibility immediately and cannot re-apply in South Carolina at the same income level unless they qualify for specific Healthy Connections categories (pregnant, disabled, or parent with income under ~62% FPL).
items.es: Asumir que Carolina del Sur ha expandido Medicaid. Carolina del Sur es uno de los 10 estados sin expansion en 2026. Los adultos que se mudan desde estados de expansion como California, Nueva York o Illinois pierden la elegibilidad de Medicaid de inmediato y no pueden volver a solicitarlo en Carolina del Sur al mismo nivel de ingresos a menos que califiquen para categorias especificas de Healthy Connections.

items.en: Waiting until the last week of the 60-day window. Marketplace enrollment processed after the 15th of a month produces coverage starting the first of the month after next, not the first of next month. A Day 55 enrollment means potentially 6 or more weeks of uncovered time.
items.es: Esperar hasta la ultima semana de la ventana de 60 dias. La inscripcion del Mercado procesada despues del dia 15 del mes produce cobertura a partir del primero del mes siguiente al siguiente. Una inscripcion en el Dia 55 significa potencialmente 6 o mas semanas sin cobertura.

items.en: Using COBRA without comparing South Carolina Marketplace plans first. COBRA costs 102% of the full premium, typically $400 to $900 per month for an individual or $1,200 to $2,800 per month for a family. South Carolina Marketplace Silver plans with 2026 premium tax credits often run $10 to $200 per month after the credit, making COBRA rarely the better choice.
items.es: Usar COBRA sin comparar primero los planes del Mercado de Carolina del Sur. COBRA cuesta el 102% de la prima completa, tipicamente $400 a $900 por mes para una persona o $1,200 a $2,800 por mes para una familia. Los planes Silver del Mercado de Carolina del Sur con creditos fiscales de 2026 a menudo cuestan $10 a $200 por mes despues del credito.

items.en: Forgetting to cancel old state coverage. Maintaining simultaneous Marketplace plans in two states creates subsidy reconciliation issues on your 1095-A tax form. The IRS will reconcile any excess advance premium tax credit on your 2026 federal return, which can produce an unexpected tax bill.
items.es: Olvidar cancelar la cobertura del estado anterior. Mantener planes del Mercado simultaneos en dos estados crea problemas de reconciliacion de subsidios en el formulario 1095-A. El IRS reconciliara cualquier credito fiscal de prima avanzado en exceso en su declaracion federal 2026.

items.en: Not checking if your children qualify for Healthy Connections Kids. Even if you do not qualify for any Healthy Connections Medicaid program, your children under 19 may qualify for Healthy Connections Kids CHIP at household incomes up to approximately 208% FPL. Healthy Connections Kids has no premiums and no cost-sharing; enrollment is year-round.
items.es: No verificar si sus hijos califican para Healthy Connections Kids. Aunque usted no califique para ningun programa Healthy Connections Medicaid, sus hijos menores de 19 anos pueden calificar para Healthy Connections Kids CHIP con ingresos hasta aproximadamente el 208% FPL. Healthy Connections Kids no tiene primas ni costo compartido; la inscripcion es durante todo el ano.

items.en: Reporting your old state's income for the ACA subsidy calculation instead of your projected South Carolina income. The Marketplace calculates subsidies based on your Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) from your move date through December 31, 2026, which may differ substantially from what you earned in your prior state.
items.es: Reportar los ingresos de su estado anterior para el calculo del subsidio del ACA en lugar de sus ingresos proyectados en Carolina del Sur. El Mercado calcula los subsidios basandose en su MAGI proyectado desde la fecha de mudanza hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2026, que puede diferir sustancialmente de lo que gano en su estado anterior.

heading.en: South Carolina's Non-Expansion Status: What It Means for Adults Moving In
heading.es: Estado de No Expansion de Carolina del Sur: Que Significa para Adultos que se Mudan

paragraphs.en: South Carolina's decision not to expand Medicaid under the ACA creates a coverage gap affecting roughly 105,000 South Carolina adults. Federal law set 100% of the Federal Poverty Level ($15,960 for a single adult in 2026) as the floor for ACA premium tax credits on the Marketplace. Without Medicaid expansion, South Carolina adults with incomes below 100% FPL have no subsidized coverage pathway: they earn too little for Marketplace subsidies and too much for traditional Healthy Connections Medicaid (which is generally unavailable to non-disabled adults without dependent children regardless of income). Healthy Connections, South Carolina's Medicaid program administered by SCDHHS at scdhhs.gov, extends standard coverage to pregnant women at approximately 194% FPL and to parents of dependent minor children at only approximately 62% FPL ($9,895 per year for a family of 2 in 2026). Non-disabled adults without dependent children receive no Healthy Connections benefit regardless of how low their income falls. Adults moving to South Carolina from an expansion state like California (Medi-Cal), New York, Massachusetts (MassHealth), or Illinois face an immediate coverage cliff if their income is below the poverty line and they are not pregnant or parents of minor children.
paragraphs.es: La decision de Carolina del Sur de no expandir Medicaid bajo el ACA crea una brecha de cobertura que afecta a aproximadamente 105,000 adultos de Carolina del Sur. La ley federal establece el 100% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($15,960 para un adulto soltero en 2026) como el piso para los creditos fiscales de prima del ACA en el Mercado. Sin la expansion de Medicaid, los adultos de Carolina del Sur con ingresos por debajo del 100% FPL no tienen un camino de cobertura subsidiada: ganan muy poco para los subsidios del Mercado y demasiado para el Healthy Connections tradicional. Healthy Connections, el programa Medicaid de Carolina del Sur administrado por SCDHHS en scdhhs.gov, extiende cobertura estandar a mujeres embarazadas hasta aproximadamente el 194% FPL y a padres de hijos menores dependientes a solo aproximadamente el 62% FPL. Los adultos sin discapacidad sin hijos dependientes no reciben ningun beneficio de Healthy Connections sin importar cuan bajos sean sus ingresos.

paragraphs.en: Adults moving to South Carolina who fall in the coverage gap (income below 100% FPL, not pregnant, not a parent of a minor child) face limited options. The ACA Marketplace cannot help below 100% FPL. Healthy Connections Medicaid cannot help without qualifying category status. Community health centers (federally qualified health centers, or FQHCs) operate across South Carolina and offer primary and preventive care on a sliding-fee scale for uninsured adults, with fees as low as $20 to $40 per visit. Find an FQHC near your South Carolina address at findahealthcenter.hrsa.gov. Free clinics and hospital charity care programs also exist in most South Carolina counties. For prescription costs, the $35 insulin cap under the IRA 2022 applies to Medicare but not to uninsured adults; GoodRx and manufacturer patient assistance programs remain the primary cost-reduction tools for the uninsured in South Carolina.
paragraphs.es: Los adultos que se mudan a Carolina del Sur y caen en la brecha de cobertura (ingresos por debajo del 100% FPL, no embarazadas, no padres de hijos menores) tienen opciones limitadas. El Mercado ACA no puede ayudar por debajo del 100% FPL. Healthy Connections Medicaid no puede ayudar sin estado de categoria calificada. Los centros de salud comunitarios (centros de salud calificados federalmente, o FQHC) operan en todo Carolina del Sur y ofrecen atencion primaria y preventiva en una escala de tarifas reducidas para adultos sin seguro, con tarifas tan bajas como $20 a $40 por visita. Encuentre un FQHC cerca de su direccion de Carolina del Sur en findahealthcenter.hrsa.gov.

heading.en: Healthy Connections Kids: South Carolina CHIP Coverage for Children After Your Move
heading.es: Healthy Connections Kids: Cobertura CHIP de Carolina del Sur para Ninos Despues de la Mudanza

paragraphs.en: Healthy Connections Kids is South Carolina's Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP), providing free coverage with no premiums and no cost-sharing for uninsured children under age 19 whose households meet income requirements. South Carolina operates Healthy Connections Kids as a Medicaid-expansion CHIP model, meaning coverage is provided through the Healthy Connections (Medicaid) infrastructure rather than a separately branded CHIP program. In 2026, Healthy Connections Kids covers children in households with incomes up to approximately 208% of the Federal Poverty Level: roughly $33,197 for a household of 1, $45,011 for a household of 2, and $68,640 for a household of 4 per SCDHHS 2026 guidelines. Enrollment is year-round with no SEP deadline required. Benefits include well-child visits, immunizations, dental care, vision, mental health, and prescription drugs. Apply through the Healthy Connections Citizen Portal at apply.scdhhs.gov or by calling SCDHHS at 1-888-549-0820. Your children may qualify for Healthy Connections Kids even if you as an adult do not qualify for any Healthy Connections Medicaid program.
paragraphs.es: Healthy Connections Kids es el Programa de Seguro de Salud para Ninos (CHIP) de Carolina del Sur, que proporciona cobertura gratuita sin primas ni costo compartido para ninos menores de 19 anos sin seguro cuyos hogares cumplen los requisitos de ingresos. Carolina del Sur opera Healthy Connections Kids como un modelo CHIP de expansion de Medicaid, lo que significa que la cobertura se proporciona a traves de la infraestructura de Healthy Connections en lugar de un programa CHIP con marca separada. En 2026, Healthy Connections Kids cubre ninos en hogares con ingresos hasta aproximadamente el 208% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza: aproximadamente $33,197 para un hogar de 1, $45,011 para un hogar de 2, y $68,640 para un hogar de 4 segun las pautas 2026 de SCDHHS. La inscripcion es durante todo el ano sin fecha limite del SEP requerida. Solicite a traves del Portal Ciudadano de Healthy Connections en apply.scdhhs.gov o llamando a SCDHHS al 1-888-549-0820.

heading.en: Documents Needed for Your South Carolina Health Coverage SEP Application
heading.es: Documentos Necesarios para su Solicitud de SEP de Cobertura Medica en Carolina del Sur

paragraphs.en: Healthcare.gov requires two categories of documentation for a move-triggered Special Enrollment Period in South Carolina: proof of South Carolina residency and proof of prior minimum essential coverage. South Carolina residency proof must show your physical address (not a PO box) and should be dated within 60 days of your move date; a signed lease or mortgage statement, a utility connection bill, or a bank statement with the South Carolina address all qualify. Prior coverage proof is the document most applicants fail to gather in advance. Your prior insurer is legally required under HIPAA Section 9831 to provide a Certificate of Creditable Coverage within a reasonable time after your coverage ends; request it by phone or email immediately after your South Carolina move. If you had Medicaid in your prior state, the termination notice from that state's Medicaid agency serves as the prior coverage document. For employer coverage, the COBRA election notice or the employer-provided coverage termination letter works. Without prior coverage documentation, healthcare.gov may pend your SEP application for manual review, which can delay your coverage start date by weeks. Request the HIPAA Certificate before you move if you can, as prior insurers sometimes take 7 to 14 days to issue it.
paragraphs.es: Healthcare.gov requiere dos categorias de documentacion para un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial activado por mudanza en Carolina del Sur: prueba de residencia en Carolina del Sur y prueba de cobertura minima esencial anterior. La prueba de residencia debe mostrar su direccion fisica y estar fechada dentro de 60 dias de la fecha de mudanza. La prueba de cobertura anterior es el documento que la mayoria de los solicitantes no reunen con anticipacion. Su aseguradora anterior esta legalmente obligada bajo la Seccion 9831 de HIPAA a proporcionar un Certificado de Cobertura Acreditable; solicítelo por telefono o correo electronico inmediatamente despues de su mudanza a Carolina del Sur. Sin esta documentacion, healthcare.gov puede poner su solicitud de SEP en revision manual, lo que puede retrasar la fecha de inicio de su cobertura por semanas. Solicite el Certificado de HIPAA antes de mudarse si puede, ya que las aseguradoras anteriores a veces tardan 7 a 14 dias en emitirlo.

heading.en: COBRA vs South Carolina Marketplace: Which Should You Choose After Moving?
heading.es: COBRA vs Mercado de Carolina del Sur: Cual Debe Elegir Despues de Mudarse?

paragraphs.en: After moving to South Carolina and leaving employer coverage in another state, two continuation pathways are typically available: COBRA continuation from your prior plan and a new ACA Marketplace plan through healthcare.gov. COBRA preserves your old plan at 102% of the full premium. For individual coverage that averaged $600 to $700 per month in total employer cost, COBRA often runs $612 to $714 per month; for family coverage that averaged $1,800 per month, COBRA runs $1,836 per month or more. COBRA is federally required for employers with 20 or more employees and lasts 18 months for most job-separations and up to 36 months for events like divorce or death. South Carolina Marketplace Silver plans, by contrast, drop most enrollees with household incomes between 100% and 400% FPL to $10 to $200 per month after 2026 premium tax credits. The trade-off is that you will likely need to select new in-network providers in South Carolina rather than retaining your prior-state doctors. The practical decision matrix: choose COBRA only if you are in the middle of an active course of treatment (surgery recovery, chemotherapy, an ongoing specialty referral) with a specific provider who is not in any South Carolina Marketplace network, or if you have already met a large annual deductible you want to preserve. Otherwise, compare healthcare.gov Silver plans first using the move SEP, and use COBRA only as a temporary bridge if needed.
paragraphs.es: Despues de mudarse a Carolina del Sur y dejar la cobertura del empleador en otro estado, dos caminos de continuacion estan tipicamente disponibles: continuacion COBRA del plan anterior y un nuevo plan del Mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov. COBRA preserva su plan anterior al 102% de la prima completa. Los planes Silver del Mercado de Carolina del Sur, por el contrario, reducen a la mayoria de inscritos con ingresos entre 100% y 400% FPL a $10 a $200 por mes despues de los creditos fiscales de prima 2026. La compensacion es que probablemente necesitara seleccionar nuevos proveedores en red en Carolina del Sur en lugar de retener a sus medicos del estado anterior. La matriz de decision practica: elija COBRA solo si esta en el medio de un curso activo de tratamiento con un proveedor especifico que no esta en ninguna red del Mercado de Carolina del Sur, o si ya cumplio un deducible anual grande que desea preservar. De lo contrario, compare primero los planes Silver de healthcare.gov usando el SEP de mudanza.

en.question: How long do I have to get health insurance after moving to South Carolina?
en.answer: You have 60 days from the date you establish South Carolina residency to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan through healthcare.gov using the move-triggered Special Enrollment Period (SEP). For example, if you moved to South Carolina on June 13, 2026, your SEP window runs through August 12, 2026. Healthy Connections Medicaid programs (including Healthy Connections Kids CHIP) have no enrollment deadline and accept applications year-round. Miss the 60-day Marketplace window and you must wait until ACA Open Enrollment, which runs November 1 through December 15, 2026 for 2027 coverage, unless another qualifying life event occurs. The 2026 to 2027 OEP is shorter than prior years under new federal rules.

en.question: Does South Carolina have Medicaid expansion? What does that mean if I move there?
en.answer: South Carolina has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA. Standard Healthy Connections (SC Medicaid) for non-disabled adults without dependent children provides no coverage at any income level. If you move from an expansion state like California, New York, or Massachusetts, your prior Medicaid ends immediately and South Carolina's Healthy Connections will not provide equivalent coverage for most adults. Pregnant women may qualify up to approximately 194% FPL. Parents of dependent minor children qualify at approximately 62% FPL, an extremely low threshold. Adults with incomes between 100% and 400% FPL should apply for ACA Marketplace subsidies at healthcare.gov. Adults below 100% FPL who are not in a qualifying category fall into South Carolina's coverage gap, which affects roughly 105,000 residents.

en.question: What is Healthy Connections Kids and can my children enroll after we move to South Carolina?
en.answer: Healthy Connections Kids is South Carolina's CHIP program, providing free coverage with no premiums or cost-sharing to uninsured children under age 19. In 2026, South Carolina covers children in households with incomes up to approximately 208% of the Federal Poverty Level. For a family of 4, that is approximately $68,640. Enrollment is year-round with no deadline; you can apply at any time after establishing South Carolina residency through the Healthy Connections Citizen Portal at apply.scdhhs.gov or by calling SCDHHS at 1-888-549-0820. Your children may qualify for Healthy Connections Kids even if you as an adult do not qualify for any Healthy Connections Medicaid program.

en.question: What documents do I need to apply for the move SEP at healthcare.gov?
en.answer: Healthcare.gov requires proof of South Carolina residency and proof of prior minimum essential coverage for at least one day in the 60 days before your move. For South Carolina residency: a signed lease, mortgage statement, utility bill, or bank statement at your South Carolina address dated within 60 days of the move. For prior coverage: a HIPAA Certificate of Creditable Coverage from your prior insurer, your prior Marketplace plan termination notice, your prior-state Medicaid termination letter, or your employer's COBRA election notice. Gather the prior coverage document before you move if possible. Without it, your SEP application may be pended for manual review, delaying coverage start by weeks. Your prior insurer must provide the HIPAA Certificate under Section 9831; request it immediately after your move.

en.question: Should I keep COBRA or switch to a South Carolina Marketplace plan?
en.answer: For most people moving to South Carolina with incomes between 100% and 400% FPL ($15,960 to $63,840 single in 2026), a South Carolina Marketplace Silver plan with premium tax credits will cost significantly less than COBRA. COBRA charges 102% of your full prior premium, often $400 to $900 per month for an individual or $1,200 to $2,800 per month for a family. South Carolina Marketplace Silver plans with credits typically run $10 to $200 per month. The 60-day window for both the move SEP and COBRA election run concurrently. Choose COBRA only if you have ongoing treatment with a specific provider who is not in any South Carolina Marketplace network, or if you have already met a large annual deductible you want to preserve for the rest of 2026.

en.question: What if I was uninsured before moving to South Carolina? Can I still enroll?
en.answer: Unfortunately, healthcare.gov's move-triggered SEP requires proof that you had minimum essential coverage for at least one day in the 60 days before your move. If you were uninsured before moving to South Carolina, you do not qualify for the move SEP. Your options are: (1) apply for Healthy Connections Kids for your children year-round at apply.scdhhs.gov, (2) apply for standard Healthy Connections if you are pregnant or meet another qualifying category, or (3) wait for the ACA Open Enrollment Period running November 1 through December 15, 2026 for 2027 coverage. Community health centers (FQHCs) in South Carolina offer sliding-scale primary care for the uninsured; find one at findahealthcenter.hrsa.gov.

en.question: Does South Carolina have its own health insurance marketplace or do I use healthcare.gov?
en.answer: South Carolina uses the federally-facilitated Marketplace, meaning all ACA plan enrollment goes through healthcare.gov. South Carolina does not operate a separate state-based exchange. Log in to healthcare.gov, enter your South Carolina ZIP code, and select your qualifying life event (moving to a new coverage area). The site will show all available 2026 plans from private insurers in your South Carolina county, with real-time estimates of your premium tax credits based on the income you enter. Six private insurers offered plans on the 2026 SC Marketplace. If you prefer assistance, navigator organizations funded under the ACA can help you enroll for free; find one at localhelp.healthcare.gov.

en.question: What happens to my ACA subsidies from my prior state when I move to South Carolina?
en.answer: Your prior state's Marketplace plan and associated premium tax credits end when you establish South Carolina residency. You must terminate the old plan in your old state's exchange or through healthcare.gov and enroll in a new plan through healthcare.gov for South Carolina. Your 2026 federal taxes will require reconciling the advance premium tax credits for both your prior-state plan and your new South Carolina plan using Form 8962 and your 1095-A tax form. Keeping two simultaneous Marketplace plans in different states creates subsidy reconciliation problems and a potential tax liability, so cancel the prior plan as soon as your South Carolina enrollment is confirmed.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo tengo para obtener seguro medico despues de mudarme a Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha en que establece residencia en Carolina del Sur para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov usando el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial por mudanza. Por ejemplo, si se mudo a Carolina del Sur el 13 de junio de 2026, su ventana del SEP va hasta el 12 de agosto de 2026. Los programas de Healthy Connections Medicaid (incluido Healthy Connections Kids CHIP) no tienen fecha limite de inscripcion y aceptan solicitudes durante todo el ano. Si pierde la ventana de 60 dias para el Mercado, debe esperar hasta la Inscripcion Abierta del ACA, que va del 1 de noviembre al 15 de diciembre de 2026 para cobertura 2027, bajo las nuevas reglas federales con ventana mas corta.

es.question: Carolina del Sur tiene la expansion de Medicaid? Que significa eso si me mudo alli?
es.answer: Carolina del Sur no ha expandido Medicaid bajo el ACA. El Healthy Connections estandar (Medicaid de SC) para adultos sin dependientes no proporciona cobertura a ningun nivel de ingresos. Si se muda desde un estado de expansion como California, Nueva York o Massachusetts, su Medicaid anterior termina inmediatamente y el Healthy Connections de Carolina del Sur no proporcionara cobertura equivalente para la mayoria de los adultos. Las mujeres embarazadas pueden calificar hasta aproximadamente el 194% FPL. Los padres de hijos menores dependientes califican a aproximadamente el 62% FPL, un umbral extremadamente bajo. Los adultos con ingresos entre el 100% y el 400% FPL deben solicitar subsidios del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov. Los adultos por debajo del 100% FPL que no esten en una categoria calificada caen en la brecha de cobertura de Carolina del Sur.

es.question: Que es Healthy Connections Kids y pueden mis hijos inscribirse despues de mudarnos a Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: Healthy Connections Kids es el programa CHIP de Carolina del Sur, que proporciona cobertura gratuita sin primas ni costo compartido para ninos menores de 19 anos sin seguro. En 2026, Carolina del Sur cubre ninos en hogares con ingresos hasta aproximadamente el 208% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. Para una familia de 4, eso es aproximadamente $68,640. La inscripcion es durante todo el ano sin fecha limite; puede solicitar en cualquier momento despues de establecer residencia en Carolina del Sur a traves del Portal Ciudadano de Healthy Connections en apply.scdhhs.gov o llamando a SCDHHS al 1-888-549-0820. Sus hijos pueden calificar para Healthy Connections Kids aunque usted no califique para ningun programa Healthy Connections Medicaid.

es.question: Que documentos necesito para solicitar el SEP de mudanza en healthcare.gov?
es.answer: Healthcare.gov requiere prueba de residencia en Carolina del Sur y prueba de cobertura minima esencial anterior durante al menos un dia en los 60 dias antes de la mudanza. Para residencia en Carolina del Sur: contrato de arrendamiento firmado, estado hipotecario, factura de servicios publicos, o estado bancario con su direccion de Carolina del Sur fechado dentro de 60 dias de la mudanza. Para cobertura anterior: Certificado de Cobertura Acreditable de HIPAA de su aseguradora anterior, aviso de terminacion del plan del Mercado anterior, carta de terminacion de Medicaid del estado anterior, o aviso de eleccion de COBRA del empleador. Reuna el documento de cobertura anterior antes de mudarse si es posible. Sin el, su solicitud de SEP puede quedar en revision manual, retrasando el inicio de cobertura por semanas.

es.question: Debo mantener COBRA o cambiar a un plan del Mercado de Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: Para la mayoria de personas que se mudan a Carolina del Sur con ingresos entre el 100% y el 400% FPL ($15,960 a $63,840 soltero en 2026), un plan Silver del Mercado de Carolina del Sur con creditos fiscales de prima costara significativamente menos que COBRA. COBRA cobra el 102% de su prima completa anterior, a menudo $400 a $900 por mes para un individuo o $1,200 a $2,800 por mes para una familia. Los planes Silver del Mercado de Carolina del Sur con creditos tipicamente cuestan $10 a $200 por mes. Elija COBRA solo si tiene tratamiento continuo con un proveedor especifico que no esta en ninguna red del Mercado de Carolina del Sur, o si ya cumplio un deducible anual grande que desea preservar para el resto del 2026.

es.question: Que pasa si no tenia seguro antes de mudarme a Carolina del Sur? Puedo inscribirme?
es.answer: Desafortunadamente, el SEP de mudanza de healthcare.gov requiere prueba de que tuvo cobertura minima esencial durante al menos un dia en los 60 dias antes de la mudanza. Si no tenia seguro antes de mudarse a Carolina del Sur, no califica para el SEP de mudanza. Sus opciones son: (1) solicitar Healthy Connections Kids para sus hijos durante todo el ano en apply.scdhhs.gov, (2) solicitar Healthy Connections estandar si esta embarazada o cumple otra categoria calificada, o (3) esperar al Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta del ACA del 1 de noviembre al 15 de diciembre de 2026. Los centros de salud comunitarios (FQHC) en Carolina del Sur ofrecen atencion primaria a escala reducida para personas sin seguro; encuentre uno en findahealthcenter.hrsa.gov.

es.question: Carolina del Sur tiene su propio mercado de seguros medicos o debo usar healthcare.gov?
es.answer: Carolina del Sur usa el Mercado federal, lo que significa que toda la inscripcion de planes ACA va a traves de healthcare.gov. Carolina del Sur no opera un mercado estatal separado. Inicie sesion en healthcare.gov, ingrese su codigo postal de Carolina del Sur y seleccione su evento calificador de vida (mudarse a una nueva area de cobertura). El sitio mostrara todos los planes de 2026 disponibles de aseguradoras privadas en su condado de Carolina del Sur. Las organizaciones de navegadores de Carolina del Sur financiadas bajo el ACA pueden ayudarle a inscribirse de forma gratuita; encuentrelas en localhelp.healthcare.gov.

es.question: Que pasa con mis subsidios del ACA de mi estado anterior cuando me mudo a Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: Su plan del Mercado del estado anterior y los creditos fiscales de prima asociados terminan cuando establece residencia en Carolina del Sur. Debe cancelar el plan anterior en el mercado de su estado anterior o a traves de healthcare.gov e inscribirse en un nuevo plan a traves de healthcare.gov para Carolina del Sur. Sus impuestos federales 2026 requeriran reconciliar los creditos fiscales de prima avanzados para ambos planes usando el Formulario 8962 y su formulario de impuestos 1095-A. Mantener dos planes del Mercado simultaneos en diferentes estados crea problemas de reconciliacion de subsidios y una posible deuda tributaria, asi que cancele el plan anterior tan pronto como su inscripcion en Carolina del Sur sea confirmada.
